title: Box plots and outliers
intro: Read quartiles, fences and modified whiskers. Compare with a standard box plot.

beats.spoken: Start in Data and Statistics with the numeric list reading on the horizontal axis.
beats.coach: Start in Data & Statistics with the numeric list reading on the horizontal axis.

beats.spoken: Open Menu then one: Plot Type then two: Box Plot. It starts as a modified box plot.
beats.coach: Open Menu → 1: Plot Type → 2: Box Plot. It starts as a modified box plot.

beats.spoken: Point at the box edges and the line inside. The first quartile is two. The median is four. The third quartile is six.
beats.coach: Point at the box edges and the line inside: Q₁ = 2, median = 4, Q₃ = 6.

beats.spoken: The interquartile range is six minus two, or four. Subtract one point five times this range from the first quartile, and add it to the third quartile.
beats.coach: IQR = 6 − 2 = 4. Subtract 1.5 × IQR from Q₁; add it to Q₃.

beats.spoken: The fences are minus four and twelve. These are calculated cutoffs, not necessarily data points.
beats.coach: The fences are −4 and 12. These are calculated cutoffs, not necessarily data points.

beats.spoken: There is no observation at minus four. The left whisker stops at zero, the smallest value inside.
beats.coach: There is no observation at −4. The left whisker stops at 0, the smallest value inside.

beats.spoken: By the mathematical rule, twelve is on the fence and stays in. thirteen is strictly beyond it.
beats.coach: By the mathematical rule, 12 is on the fence and stays in. 13 is strictly beyond it.

beats.spoken: In Plot Properties, choose Extend Box Plot Whiskers. This makes a standard box plot.
beats.coach: In Plot Properties, choose Extend Box Plot Whiskers. This makes a standard box plot.

beats.spoken: The whiskers now run from zero to thirteen. The quartiles stay the same; thirteen is not marked separately.
beats.coach: The whiskers now run from 0 to 13. The quartiles stay the same; 13 is not marked separately.

beats.spoken: Choose Show Box Plot Outliers to return to the modified plot.
beats.coach: Choose Show Box Plot Outliers to return to the modified plot.

beats.spoken: Report the fence and the observed whisker separately.
beats.coach: Report the fence and the observed whisker separately.
